課程綱要.開課單位: 永續綠能科技碩士學位學程
課程綱要.課程目標: 建立學生對切換式電源的概念，瞭解如何分析電路特性與參數設計，並應用於再生能源轉換器，進而培養學生對期刊閱讀的能力。
課程綱要.授課內容: 主要介紹固態能量的轉換，包括電能轉換之基本原理及交直流及直交流電能轉換的技術及其應用。
課程綱要.教科書/參考書: “參考書：電力電子控制( Control in Power Electronics, MARIAN P. KAZMIERKOWSKI, ACADEMIC PRESS)“
課程綱要.評量配分比重: 作業成績 30％ 期中報告 35％ 期末報告 35％

8 Advanced Collectors --- Concentrating Collector
9 Thermal Energy Storage
10 Application of Solar Thermal Systems

課程綱要.開課單位: 永續綠能科技碩士學位學程
課程綱要.課程名稱(英文): Advanced Electric Motor Drives and Control
課程綱要.課程目標: Assure students familiar the technologies of power converters, motor drives and their important applications.
課程綱要.授課內容:
課程概述：Electric machines have been the workhorses of industry for many years. Combined with the advanced power electronics, microprocessor technologies and control theories, the electric motor drives have become sophisticated, and make many high-performance industrial applications possible. Therefore, for the graduated students major in electric power and control, the knowledge of the modern technologies of the electric motor drives is necessary.
課程目標：Assure students familiar the technologies of power converters, motor drives and their important applications.
Power Converters
1. Introduction to power semiconductor devices
2. Switch-mode DC-DC converters
3. Switch-mode DC-AC inverters
Fundamental Motor Drives
4. DC motor drives
5. Induction motor drives
6. Synchronous motor drives
Advanced Motor Drives
7. D-Q model of AC machines
8. Vector control of AC machines
9. Ultrasonic motor drives
Paper Study
10. Final Presentation
課程綱要.教科書/參考書: 教科書 B. K. Bose, Power Electronics and AC drives. Prentice-Hall, 1986 Mohan, Undeland and Robbins, Power Electronics. John Wiley ＆ Sons, 1995 參考書 Related papers in motor drives and control technologies, 2001-2008
課程綱要.評量配分比重: Midterm examination 35％ Computer simulation home works 20％ Final report and presentation 40％ Learning attitude 5％
課程綱要.彈性教學說明: 依授課教師課堂上說明
